exposure: length of the second phase of delivery
outcome: Fear of childbirth (FOC) pre- and postpartum
finding: FOC pre-partum, anxiety sensitivity, mode of delivery, and birth experience were major predictors for high FOC post-partum.
mod_finding: Higher FOC pre-partum was associated with instrumental delivery and emergency CS, and FOC post-partum was associated with both mode of delivery and length of the second stage of delivery.
